source_scope: Complete extracted core Rules booklet; advanced modules excluded.
grading: Correct = all requested material facts match the key. Partial = correct facts but one or more requested facts are missing or explicitly unsupported. Incorrect = at least one material contradictory ruling. A correct but unsupported assertion is separately noted; it does not prove summary coverage. No partial-credit weighting is used in the headline fully-correct count.

answers.answer: Shuffle 12 Speed, 3 Starting Upgrade and 3 Stress cards (18 total) into the draw deck. Put 6 Heat face up in the Engine. Start in 1st gear and draw 7 cards.
Staying in the same gear is allowed. A two-position shift such as 1st to 3rd costs 1 Heat, paid immediately during Shift Gears by moving a Heat card from Engine to discard.
No. Commit exactly 3 playable cards face down in the Play Area.

Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous across players, in that order. After everyone finishes them, take steps 3–9 one player at a time, each completing their turn before the next, from front to back. The car closest to the Race Line acts first when side by side.
Cars do not block passage. If the destination is full, stop in the first space with a free spot behind the blocking cars, preferring the spot closest to the Race Line.

Discard the flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade. Put Speed 3 in the Play Area on the played Stress; the Stress remains in that area until normal cleanup. It contributes speed 3. Resolve all Stress before Adrenaline.
The last two cars to move receive Adrenaline. Each gains access to 1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 speed during React, before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be carried over.
Yes. React symbols may be activated in any order. 2nd gear gives Cooldown 1, so first move the Heat from hand to Engine, then pay that Heat from Engine to discard for one Boost.

At most once per turn, costing 1 Heat from Engine to discard. An empty Engine prevents Boost unless Heat is first returned via available Cooldown. Flip and discard non-Speed cards until a Speed card appears; add that card to played cards and move its value. Boost speed counts for corners.
Slipstream is optional and moves 2 spaces without increasing speed. Because it crosses a Corner Line, check speed 6 against limit 4 and pay 2 Heat.
Check both corners in crossing order, using the total speed 8 for each. Pay 2 Heat for limit 6 and 4 for limit 4, totaling 6 Heat.

The corner requires 3 Heat but only 2 are available, so pay both Engine Heat into discard and spin out. Move to the first available space before that corner, take 2 Stress directly into hand, and set gear to 1st.
Speed cards may be voluntarily discarded; Stress and Heat may not. Nobody may browse discard piles, including their own. Only each pile's top card is public.
Move all Play Area cards to discard, then draw only enough to reach a hand of 7.
Immediately shuffle the discard pile into a new draw deck, excluding cards still in the Play Area, then continue the required flips.

Payment moves Heat from Engine to discard; later reshuffles and draws bring it to hand. Cooldown moves Heat from hand back to Engine. Heat cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand.

Commit the two playable cards and cover the remaining two slots with Heat. Move zero spaces, set gear to 1st, discard all four committed cards, and skip directly to Replenish Hand. React is skipped, so no cooling this turn.

Crossing first during the round does not guarantee victory. Among finishers that round, the furthest ahead wins; closest to the Race Line breaks a side-by-side tie. Remove finished cars at the end of the round and rank them on the Hall of Fame.
No Slipstream across the final finish line and no Slipstream after crossing it. Ignore speed limits for corners beyond that line on the final lap.
Both remaining cars receive Adrenaline because eligibility for one versus two cars is determined by the six cars that started, not the remaining field.
Use the lap count printed on the board. USA normally uses 2 laps; a first learning race may use 1 lap.
Check the selected game board for starting Heat and Stress quantities. Six Heat and three Stress are the typical example, not a universal override of the board.
Randomly assign participating cars to the starting grid, placing them one at a time into spots in ascending order. This establishes first-round order; preferred positions are not freely chosen.
Place the remaining Stress cards face up near the board as a reserve.
The experienced driver may remove 1 or 2 Heat from their own car to level the playing field. It is an optional handicap, not extra Heat added to beginners.
No three-position shift is offered. Stay in gear, shift one position for free, or at most two positions for 1 Heat. Paying additional Heat does not grant a three-position shift.
No. The double-shift Heat is paid immediately in step 1 from Engine to discard. Later React/Cooldown cannot fund an earlier shift cost, and Heat in hand cannot pay it directly.

Resolve each Stress separately and add its found Speed card to the Play Area on that Stress. Total speed is 2 + 3 + 4 = 9. Only the original three cards were committed from hand; the found cards are added during resolution, not additional hand commitments.
No. Move exactly the summed speed, 8 spaces here. Mandatory movement cannot be shortened voluntarily to avoid a corner.
Use total speed 8, not the shortened distance. Blocking changes placement, not the revealed total speed. Pay 2 Heat for the crossed limit-6 corner.
No. Check a corner only after crossing its Corner Line. Mere proximity without a crossing does not trigger that corner payment.
No. Speed equal to or below the limit requires no Heat. An empty Engine alone does not cause a spin out; insufficient Heat matters only when a positive corner cost is owed.
Successfully pay all 3 Heat to discard and continue. Exact payment is enough; ending with an empty Engine does not itself trigger a spin out.

Pay 2 Heat for the first corner, leaving 3. The second requires 4, so pay the remaining 3 and spin out at the second corner. Return to the first available space before that second corner, take 2 Stress into hand, and set gear to 1st. All 5 initial Engine Heat have been discarded.
Take 1 extra Stress directly into hand and set gear to 1st. The low-gear penalty is one Stress, rather than the two for 3rd/4th gear.
1st gear provides Cooldown 3. Adrenaline adds 1, so up to 4 Heat can return from hand to Engine. These are available effects to activate; using every available Cooldown is not compulsory.
Yes. The extra speed is optional and the extra Cooldown is separately available. Declining the speed does not remove access to Adrenaline cooling.
Yes, the last car to move gets Adrenaline even after overtaking into the lead; eligibility is based on turn order. With four starters only that last car gets it, not the second-to-last.
Being next to a car or in the space directly behind one qualifies. If neither relationship is present, Slipstream is unavailable. If eligible it remains optional.
Yes. React/Boost occurs before Slipstream, so use the position after Boost when checking eligibility at the Slipstream step.
Just one optional two-space Slipstream move. Multiple nearby cars do not multiply the movement into four spaces.

Do not share an occupied spot. Apply the blocked-destination rule: place in the first space with a free spot behind the blocking cars, closest to the Race Line if available. Slipstream does not add to corner-check speed, whether its movement is shortened or not.
The pre-finish corner still requires 4 Heat. Ignore only the post-finish corner limit. Crossing the final finish line does not waive a corner crossed before it.
Yes, an otherwise legal Slipstream can cross on an intermediate lap. Normal corner limits still apply; the Slipstream prohibition and post-line speed-limit exception concern the final lap only.
Continue rounds until all cars have reached the finish. Establishing the winner does not end play for unfinished cars.
Check Corner concerns crossing a Corner Line. The Legends Line is used only in advanced play and is not a core-game corner-payment trigger.

No. Shifting down one to 2nd is free and happens before card commitment. Current gear then requires only two cards, so commit the two playable cards and take a normal turn; the previous gear does not force Cluttered Hand.
